key.name: ui-language
key.description: Use the system language, Vietnamese, or English in preferences and widgets.

key.name: show-clock
key.description: Show or hide the macOS Tahoe-style large clock on the left side of the desktop.

key.name: show-weather
key.description: Show or hide the weather widget.

key.name: show-system
key.description: Show or hide the system resource monitor (CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, and network).

key.name: show-lunar
key.description: Show or hide the Vietnamese lunar calendar widget.

key.name: show-rest
key.description: Show or hide the uptime and break reminder widget.

key.name: weather-api-key
key.description: OpenWeatherMap API key. Leave blank to use free Open-Meteo weather data.

key.name: weather-city
key.description: City used for weather data (for example, Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, or Quy Nhon).

key.name: weather-lat
key.description: Geographic latitude used for weather data.

key.name: weather-lon
key.description: Geographic longitude used for weather data.

key.name: weather-update-interval
key.description: How often to refresh weather data automatically.

key.name: position-mode
key.description: Choose between positioning the widget group or positioning each widget individually.

key.name: widget-clock-x
key.description: Distance from the left edge of the desktop to the clock in individual mode.

key.name: widget-clock-y
key.description: Distance from the top edge of the desktop to the clock in individual mode.

key.name: widget-weather-x
key.description: Distance from the right edge of the desktop to the weather widget in individual mode.

key.name: widget-weather-y
key.description: Distance from the top edge of the desktop to the weather widget in individual mode.

key.name: widget-system-x
key.description: Distance from the right edge of the desktop to the system widget in individual mode.

key.name: widget-system-y
key.description: Distance from the top edge of the desktop to the system widget in individual mode.

key.name: widget-lunar-x
key.description: Distance from the right edge of the desktop to the lunar widget in individual mode.

key.name: widget-lunar-y
key.description: Distance from the top edge of the desktop to the lunar widget in individual mode.

key.name: widget-rest-x
key.description: Distance from the right edge of the desktop to the break reminder widget in individual mode.

key.name: widget-rest-y
key.description: Distance from the top edge of the desktop to the break reminder widget in individual mode.

key.name: clock-gap-x
key.description: Distance from the left edge of the desktop to the large clock.

key.name: clock-gap-y
key.description: Distance from the top edge of the desktop to the large clock.

key.name: stack-gap-x
key.description: Distance from the right edge of the desktop to the widget group.

key.name: stack-gap-y
key.description: Distance from the top edge of the desktop to the first widget.
